page.overview:
Who is Viktora?

Viktora is a character and playable unit in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Elegant Dragoon and the Wintertime Zephyr, she is a dragoon affiliated with Wezette.

Although she debuts as a supporting character and ally to Glaciela Wezette, her machinations expose her as a central antagonist intending to claim the throne of Wezette for herself in an indirect conflict with Glaciela herself. Viktora is almost always seen with the company of her partner, Luartha.

Viktora is a pale-skinned young woman with long silver hair wrapped up on a scarf with longer strands on the right side of her face and a metallic spiky headpiece. She dons a set of armored clothing that exposes part of her skin and cleavage, and a flowing skirt with unclothed segments. Her long silvery sleeves expose her shoulders, and she wears armored gauntlets. She wears tights and a pair of heeled boots. In combat Viktora employs a spear with a long tip and two curved blades at the base, with the upper section of the handle being wrapped in what appears to be a scarf with a blue pattern. Viktora equips the Greed Armor, a shoulder protector mounted on her left shoulder with multiple segments and a winged protrusion on top. What appears to be a set of furred cape originates from this equipment.

Viktora is an unapologetic manipulator and a self-centered schemer. Cunning and underhanded, Viktora presents a warm and reliable exterior, which she uses to make those around her lower their guard and trick them for her own benefit, having no qualms about betraying others for her own needs. Vain to a fault, Viktora is self-aware of her beauty, which she takes great care of polishing. She only spends money for this purpose, being stingy otherwise, knowing that her external charm helps her deceive others.
